chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', from Isma'il ibn Zayd, from Abdullah al-Tahhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: There is no one on the Day of Judgment except that he wishes he were among the visitors of al-Husayn, because of what he sees being done for the visitors of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) in terms of their honour before Allah, the Exalted.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting Imam al-Husayn on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this universal promise where every soul on the Day of Judgment will envy the visitors of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) for the divine honor they receive. This highlights the unique intercessory status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia eschatology, positioning Ziyarah not merely as a ritual but as a source of eternal spiritual distinction and divine favor.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn Walīd narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl ibn Bazī’, from Ismā’īl ibn Zayd, from ‘Abdillāh Al-Ťaḥḥān, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: On the Day of Judgment, everyone will wish to be among those who had gone to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) because they will see the way in which the Zuwwār of Ḥusain (a.s.) will be honoured and treated by Allāh.
